_readme: GOLDEN ENDINGS CORPUS — the spec ratchet for the awaiting-◐ text classification.
Each entry: a real (or incident-derived) final-response ending and the tab state the TEXT
layer must produce (expect: 'awaiting' | 'idle'). The classifier under test is
endsOnQuestion(text).ends || solicitsReply(text) — the .ask-flag layer is separate.
RULES: APPEND-ONLY. Never delete or relabel an entry without Andrew's explicit sign-off —
the corpus is the memory of past incidents, and the cliff is a change that un-learns one.
Sources: 'incident' = a real production miss; 'real-log' = harvested from _debug.log tails;
